entities.summary: Carole Dieschbourg is a Luxembourgish writer and politician of The Greens. She was Minister for the Environment in the Bettel I and II coalition governments from 2013 to 2022. She represented Luxembourg at the COP22 Climate Change Conference in Marrakesh, November 2016.
